svg.text: The same corrupted sentence, read at several granularities
shared Mixer (rank r), computed once, feeds every level
1 position each (windows of 27 and 81 bytes), routed to image, audio, video, metadata
Decode: ConvTranspose1d + Mixer per scale, back to 27 positions
concat (S·d), RMSNorm, Linear: one vector h per byte
